description: The chart represents the distribution of various medical ethics principles, categorized into four main sections. The chart is divided into 24 slices, each representing a specific principle or sub-principle. The four main categories are Beneficence (blue, approximately 40%), Autonomy (green, approximately 25%), Non-Maleficence (purple, approximately 20%), and Justice (orange/peach, approximately 15%). The Beneficence category is further divided into eight sub-slices, including "Respect Life, Dignity of Patients" and "Provide Medical Care to Patients", with labels written inside the slices. The Autonomy category has five sub-slices, such as "Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication" and "Keep Confidential Information of Patient and Their Relatives". The Non-Maleficence category has six sub-slices, including "Prevent Patient from Harm" and "Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct". The Justice category has five sub-slices, such as "Promote the Health of Community" and "Allocate Medical Sources Fairly". The chart does not include a legend, but the colors used for each category are distinct. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice, "Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues", starting at the top-left. The proportions of the slices vary, with some being larger than others, and are visually ordered by category and then by size within each category.
